title: Proposed experiment testing Penrose gravitational collapse with entangled nanocrystals

tellings.quote: And actually a recent experiment was just proposed um called the G experiment taking two um two nano crystals entangle them magnetically

plain: A newly proposed experiment would entangle two tiny crystals magnetically to test the physicist Roger Penrose's idea that gravity makes quantum states collapse into one definite outcome. Matthew Pines describes it on the show, linking it to Penrose and the scientist Stuart Hameroff, and calls it the "G experiment." If it worked, it would test a theory Penrose and Hameroff have tied to how consciousness arises.
